book.name: Wahyu
book.title: Makromod Yesus nalhari panaeku Yohanis mehen do'on Wahyu

content: Pipdumana mehe nodi molollo hari horok lunlunne
Onne horu ya'u po'on haida wali'ur. Ya'u po'on Ai ma naikokoro lolo naikoronno onne nasasala horok lunlunna ida aile liman malanne. Horok onne horhorok waliwali la rodi segel wo'ikku segsegel.
Enime'ede ya'u po'on hophopon a'am raram ma naruri ida, wakau na'ukani, “Inhoi nin molollo aile hari horok eni nina segele?”
Enimaa nano ri man aile noho wawan, a'am raram, me noho wi'in, ri mahaku ka nodi molollo hari horok onne, lese.
Kame'ede ya'u raram penu, de ahere nammori, ono ri mahaku ka nodi molollo hari horok onne, lese.

Ma namwali leleher lalapida nano ri werro'o wo'akka onnenihe na'aheni maya'u, “Heih! Yon mahere me'e ono Ri ida aile man rehiyedi ara Nin arwali me'e. Ai naran Singa, la Ai nano hair Yehuda, la Daud Upun Anan. Ai penia nodi molollo nohu segel onnenihe la hari horok lunlunna onne, lese.”

Enime'ede ya'u po'on Pipdumana ida aile namririnohi naikoronno onneni, la ha mormori wo'akka roro ma namwali leleher lalap onnenihe pepepen Ai. Ya'u po'on Ai kemen naise resnedi nonolu me'e. Ai dudalle wo'ikku la makan wo'ikku. Makan wo'ikku onne na'ono Makromod Lalap Nina Roh wo'ikku man An hopon laa lolo noho wawan na'akeme.
Pipdumana onne laa kalari nala horok lunlunne nano Ai ma naikokoro lolo naikoronno onne liman malanna.

Ai naledi horok onneni ne, ha mormori wo'akka roro leleher lalap werro'o wo'akka onnenihe laa yawa rahinononow lolo kalarna. Hi dohodoho rasala haida naise kecapi noro manuk man rodi maha hi'ie. Manuk onnenihe penpenu noro wuru man wola'ula'u ma namwali lir napanak man Makromod Lalap Nin ri mememen na'akeme hi'ie.

content.text: “O penia ma namlolo,
de Num molollo aile mala horok onneni
we'er nina segel enihe,
ono resnedi O me'e,
la noro Num rara ma nakliu onneni,
Om weliyedi ri mormori noho wawan na'akeme me'e,
ri nano hair-hair, noho-noho, la nano wanakunu na'akeme,
leke ramwali Makromod Lalap Nina ri.
Om niliyedi hi leke ramwali hair mahaku,
la ramwali imam-imam man ilitolle ik Makromod Lalap,
la ramwali rai-rai leke rodi molollo lolo noho wawan na'akeme.”

content: Horu ne, ya'u po'on wali'ur la derne hophopon a'am raram nammori lirna, kar akinala hi. Hir pepepen Rai Nin naikoronno, ha mormori wo'akka roro leleher lalap onnenihe.

content.text: “Pipdumana man resnedi eni, Num molollo aile,
de am horhawa O,
ai ma'uli masa'a O,
la ai ma'akulu ma'alapa O Oin Naran.
Am kukunohi Num molollo,
am wakunkunu Num kanaru,
am kukunohi Num woroin ma narehi ma nalewen,
la am wakunu wali'ur Num ke'eke'el an'anhe!”

content: Enime'ede ya'u derne ha man mormori na'akeme lolo a'am raram, a'am lehern, lolo lour ro, la noho wi'in rahinara ra'aheni,

content.text: “Ai ma naikoro lolo Nin naikoronno noro Pipdumana onneni,
ai ma'uli masa'e,
am horhawe,
ai ma'akulu ma'alapa Hi Oin Naran,
la am wakunkunu Rir ke'eke'el an'anha laa ewi-ewi!”

content: Ha mormori wo'akka onnenihe walhe ra'aheni, “Amin!” Ri leleher lalap onnenihe laa yawa rahinononow ra'uli rasa'a Hi haenhi.
